edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged account.
initOwner is gated by onlyFromFactory, so msg.sender decides whether _owner can be set.
addModule is gated by onlyFromFactoryOrModule using msg.sender.
transact is gated by onlyFromFactoryOrModule using msg.sender.
fallback resolves methodToModule[msg.sig] and requires modules[module], caller-driven dispatch.
addGuardian is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
removeGuardian is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
removeAllGuardians calls requireWalletModule(msg.sender) before deleting guardians.
touchLastActive is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
setLock is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
setInheritor is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
addToSpent is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
addToWhitelist is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
removeFromWhitelist is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
verifyAndUpdate calls requireWalletModule(msg.sender) before consuming a hash.
AddOfficialGuardianModule.activate trusts msg.sender as the wallet address.
addGuardian requires validSince >= block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable timestamp check.
removeGuardian requires validUntil >= block.timestamp.
touchLastActive writes lastActive = uint64(block.timestamp).
touchLastActiveWhenRequired compares block.timestamp to lastActive + minInterval.
setInheritor stores block.timestamp as lastActive, driving inheritance timing.
Quota availability and rolling spend decay are computed from block.timestamp.
addToSpent stores spentTimestamp = uint64(block.timestamp).
addToWhitelist clamps effectiveTime with block.timestamp.
AddOfficialGuardianModule.activate passes block.timestamp as validSince to addGuardian.
mode parameter selects which low-level call type _call executes.
to parameter becomes the call target in _call.
value parameter is forwarded as Ether in _call.
data parameter is forwarded as calldata in _call.
transact delegates execution to private _call.
success local is assigned from the _call result.
returnData local is assigned from the _call result.
transact reverts through inline assembly when the call fails.
_call performs an arbitrary external CALL with Ether value, allowing re-entry into the wallet.
_call performs an arbitrary DELEGATECALL, letting target code run in wallet context and re-enter.
_call performs an arbitrary STATICCALL to the target.
Attacker-influenced to address is the CALL target.
Attacker-influenced value is sent with the CALL.
Attacker-influenced data is the CALL payload.
fallback forwards msg.data and msg.value to the bound module before returning, enabling re-entrant calls.
fallback reads methodToModule[msg.sig] to resolve the target module.
fallback requires modules[module] to be true before dispatching.
Resolved module address is stored in the module local variable.
The resolved module local is the receiver of the low-level call.
modules mapping gates whether the resolved module may be called.
addModule delegates to internal _addModule.
init loops over initial modules calling _addModule.
_module parameter is the module being registered.
_module parameter is the target of the activate callback.
_addModule calls Module(_module).activate() after setting modules[_module] = true, an external callback.
_addModule sets modules[_module] = true controlling later authorization.
removeModule executes Module(_module).deactivate() in a try/catch, an external callback with ignored failure.
removeModule deletes modules[_module] revoking authorization.
setOwner writes _owner and is restricted to modules.
initOwner writes _owner exactly once from the factory.
setOwner requires newOwner != _owner, reading the protected owner slot.
initOwner requires controller != address(0) before writing _owner.
setController replaces the controller that gates the factory and stores.
transferOwnership under onlyOwner rewrites owner.
renounceOwnership under onlyOwner sets owner to address(0).
newOwner parameter is the target of the ownership transfer.
bindMethod writes methodToModule and is restricted to wallet modules.
activate calls bindMethods for the calling wallet.
deactivate calls unbindMethods for the calling wallet.
bindMethods calls wallet.bindMethod, an external callback into the wallet for each selector.
unbindMethods calls wallet.bindMethod(selector, address(0)) externally.
addGuardian reads and writes the wallet guardian struct in the wallets mapping.
removeGuardian reads and writes the wallet guardian struct.
cancelPendingGuardians mutates guardian status and timestamps.
removeAllGuardians deletes the guardians array and index entries.
wallet parameter selects the guardian struct to modify.
validSince parameter is stored as the guardian timestamp.
addr parameter is the guardian being added.
wallet parameter selects the guardian struct to modify.
validUntil parameter is stored as the pending removal timestamp.
addr parameter is the guardian being removed.
changeQuota writes quotas using toUint128/toUint64 downcasts on caller-supplied values.
checkAndAddToSpent reads the quota struct and updates spent accounting.
addToSpent writes spentAmount and spentTimestamp into the quota struct.
checkAndAddToSpent calls priceOracle.tokenValue, an external oracle call for value conversion.
newQuota parameter flows into changeQuota and the uint128 downcast.
amount parameter flows into quota availability comparison.
amount parameter is added to the spent quota.
addToWhitelist writes the effective time used for whitelist authorization.
removeFromWhitelist deletes the effective time entry.
verifyAndUpdate marks hashes[wallet][hash] consumed after module authorization.
register performs multiple external ENS registry and resolver calls driven by manager input.
AddOfficialGuardianModule.activate calls securityStore.addGuardian.
activate calls BaseWallet(wallet).removeModule on the caller wallet, re-entering the wallet.
transactCall calls Wallet(wallet).transact, an external call that then performs an arbitrary call.
reimburseGasFee routes the token transfer through transactCall/transactTokenTransfer.
reimburseGasFee charges the quota before paying out the gas fee.

normalization_plan.reason: mode only steers which low-level call _call performs, so it should be folded into the _call node.
to is the raw call target consumed only by _call.
value is forwarded verbatim by _call to the low-level call.
data is forwarded verbatim by _call as calldata.
newOwner is the sole argument of transferOwnership and has no independent state.
_module identifies the module registered and activated by _addModule.
wallet indexes the guardian struct mutated by addGuardian.
validSince is stored as the guardian timestamp inside addGuardian.
addr is the guardian identity written by addGuardian.
validUntil is stored as the pending removal timestamp inside removeGuardian.
newQuota is downcast and written into the quota struct by changeQuota.
amount is the spending value compared and added to the quota by checkAndAddToSpent.
success is a transient flag used only inside transact.
returnData is produced by the call and consumed by the assembly revert path.
module is the resolved call target used only by the low-level call in fallback.
